QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] A Disturbance in the Phantasm
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has a request for you in Tallahart. Go see Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: A suspicious magical reaction was detected in the city outskirts. Locate its source.\r\n#b(* If you fail, you can forfeit the quest and start over.)
QuestInfo.2: The source was the Knights of the Einherjar! After capturing them, you transferred them to the Alliance's care.
